OGL-Canada 2.0 permits copying, modifying, publishing and redistributing the information, commercially and non-commercially, with attribution, so the standing defaults apply: our code and documentation are MIT, and our rights in the derived compilation are dedicated CC0-1.0. The source's own terms are preserved, never relicensed: every copy of the data carries the OGL-Canada attribution statement, and the dataset is labelled as derived, never as a TSB official product. The dedication covers only our contribution: the underlying TSB RODS data keep their own designation and remain subject to OGL-Canada 2.0, whose attribution condition carries through to every copy of the derived data. Nothing here relicenses the source or presents CC0 as the source's terms.
